sentences.imagePrompt: Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. Cozy home interior with a closed front door. Use the fixed first-person young girl: preschool to early elementary age, shoulder-length dark brown hair, small pink hair clip, yellow top, coral-red pinafore dress, red shoes, warm expression. She has just stood up from a small chair or cushion and is going toward the closed door, one hand reaching for the doorknob to open it. Make the standing-up movement, walking direction, closed door, and opening action clear.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. Friendly reading corner or playroom with floor cushions. Use the fixed first-person young girl in yellow top and coral-red pinafore sitting on one cushion and inviting the fixed second-person young boy to come to this side and sit together: same age, short slightly tousled dark hair, sky-blue shirt, green shorts, blue shoes, small orange backpack. The girl pats an empty cushion beside her while the boy walks toward her. Show a clear nearby sitting place on the girl's side.

sentences.imagePrompt: Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. Home doorway scene. A small friendly dog is sitting directly in front of the door and blocking the way. Use the fixed first-person young girl in yellow top and coral-red pinafore standing nearby, gently gesturing for the dog to move away from the doorway, kind but clear. The dog is beginning to get up and walk away from the door. The doorway and the blocked front-of-door position must be obvious.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. A large closed front door is the main object. Use the fixed first-person young girl in yellow top and coral-red pinafore walking toward the big door with one hand reaching for the handle because it is not open yet. The door should clearly still be closed, and her action of going to open it should be easy to understand.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. Simple classroom or playroom divided visually into two sides by furniture placement, with no written signs. On the near side, there is an empty open area beside a low table and cushions; absolutely no person is standing there. People may be visible far on the other side sitting or standing away from this side, so the meaning is clear: no one is standing on this side. Keep the empty near-side area visually central.

sentenceGames.prompt: 小兔子找不到開。請在句子裡找到開，按一下。
小兔子讀到一個不會念的字。請按住紅框的字教牠念。
有一個字不見了。請按下面的字卡，把它找回來。
請照聽到的順序，把字放回句子裡。
小兔子請三個朋友念。先按朋友的頭聽，再按念對的朋友旁邊的勾勾。
